name: Onna no Ko no Shikumi
source:
This game has stories for 3 girls, with 2 stories each. They are picture stories of course.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160403171040/http://members.shaw.ca:80/lisun/jhag-wns.htm]Li's Fun House[/url]]
translation:
本作收录三名女孩的故事，每人各有两篇。当然，这些都是以图片呈现的故事。

[引自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160403171040/http://members.shaw.ca:80/lisun/jhag-wns.htm]Li's Fun House[/url]]
